notes.title: First Update!
notes.notes:
Hey players,
Thank you for all the support with Ever Forward!
We've received a lot of reviews and feedback since the release. 
Please enjoy your experience with the first update. 😊
 
First update includes:

 Fixed the pathway issue in DLC level 2
 Fixed the lighting  issue in DLC
 Fixed the issue in the gravity puzzle level 3, a cube dropping problem. 
 Fixed the issue of not triggering video in the gravity puzzle level 3
 Fixed issues that sometimes gravity puzzles can't reset correctly
 Fixed the issue of the music repeating in the final scene
 Fixed the sound effects problems in the DLC puzzles
 Fixed the issue of when Maya jumps down from a cube causing the player to lose control 
 Fixed the lightmap issue
 Fixed the terrain collision error
 Fixed the issue of being able to fly over the island
 Adjusted the default resolution ratio to avoid lags on some PC models
 Calibrated English subtitles
 Adjusted the cast list
 Added more music when Maya is on the island
 Added a hidden achievement related to the elder Maya
 Adjusted some sound effects for cutscenes

notes.title: Ever Forward Release date CONFIRMED!
notes.notes:
Hey gang! Its official and we finally have a release date set! I feel like this is my wedding date lol. She said yes! Haha no, I’m joking…. August 13th, Ever Forward will be released!!! The game starts at $14.99 and during the first week there will be a 10% discount. 

We are full of gratitude, appreciation, and respect for the players that have supported us through this journey.
We have taken the awesome feedback you guys gave for the demo prologue and tried to include all that in the final build. You all wanted a better tutorial, more puzzles and more interaction. We have done all that and more: there are many new puzzles that will absolutely blow your mind and challenge you until you’re blue in the face and ready to throw your controller... out of pure joy! We’ve also added a few challenge puzzles for galaxy brain IQ 200 players who think they can handle it. Spoiler: you can’t handle it. Better optimization, music and general polish will help the gaming experience be smoother and hopefully just a more enjoyable experience. 

For all you Maya fans-New animation and actions for Maya will help you to solve puzzles faster. And of course, the full version of the game will bring you the thrilling conclusion to Maya’s narrative; you can finally know exactly what happened to her and why her world even exists… 

I must leave you with this…  (Going back to work) 
We want to make the best games we can make, for the people who will enjoy it. We whole heartily believe that games, especially in this day and age are essential to life and happiness for many people. When we’re in over our heads in life, games can be the winds in our sails to get back to safe waters. Often when dealing with adverse times, games are the best way to release the tension and pressures of life. For many of us, games are the light at the end of, sometimes, the dark tunnels life puts you in. It’s our duty and our joy to make dope games that are more than just entertainment. We take great honor and pride in the role we play as game developers. We want our games to excite people and be used as a platform for spreading love and happiness. Thus far this experience of connecting with gamers and hearing / seeing what people share and how they solve our puzzles has been the best part for us. None of us expected this community to be so impactful and supportive of our project, we are truly humbled. The Devs….
